planets.name: HD 80606 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 80606 with a 111-day year, found in 2001.

text.card: HD 80606 b was found in 2001 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 80606. Its orbit and size follow Pearson et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: HD 80606 b
quotes.card: HD 80606 b is an eccentric hot Jupiter 217 light-years from the Sun in the constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: HD 80606 b was discovered orbiting the star HD 80606 in April 2001 by a team led by Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz.
